summary: Discovery and gaps is one page, new admins get their mail reliably, and the menu flags only what needs you.

new.title: Discovery and gaps in one page
new.text: Discovery and gaps is now one page under Access.

new.title: New admin wizard asks where mail goes
new.text: The New admin wizard asks where the admin's mail goes, so the Temporary Access Pass reaches the admin.

fixes.title: Menu numbers only when you must act
fixes.text: The menu shows a number only for an error or a blocking approval.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The policy page shows the recommendation, External companies saves from the row, and Delegation overview and Access map scroll properly.
